title: claytonia macilenta
intro: Claytonia macilenta, commonly known as Miner's lettuce, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Portulacaceae family. It is a succulent with edible leaves, stems, and flowers, which have been traditionally used for their nutritional value and potential health benefits. The leaves of Miner's lettuce are rich in vitamins A, C, and K, as well as minerals like calcium and iron, making it a valuable addition to a healthy diet. The therapeutic actions of Claytonia macilenta include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and other polyphenolic compounds.
